summary: RS actions are not getting executed
description: customer complained that 5-10% of all actions are not getting executed. He said it's across all clusters.
solution:
Check for the size of the actions, if they are small, the RS action maker will just skip them. 
In Pod Rightsizing, recommendations and actions are related but not identical.

A new optimization action should come from a recommendation run that found something actionable.

But an Action object can remain in Active state even when the current run has nothing new to optimize.

So seeing an Action does not always mean “there is a new optimization to apply right now” -it can also represent an already-managed workload or a previously applied optimization state.
